description: A 2.9" black/white(/red/yellow) e-Paper display module with an SPI-style interface. Pinout confirmed directly from Wokwi's own community board source (github.com/wokwi/wokwi-boards), not the docs site (its docs page 404s).
how_to_use: VCC/GND power. BUSY/RST/DC/CS/CLK/DIN are the control/data/clock lines the microcontroller drives — an SPI-style protocol, but named DIN/CLK rather than MOSI/SCK, so NOT recognized by (or protected by) this project's SPI-bus mechanism, which only matches the exact names MOSI/MISO/SCK/DO/DI.
